claims.claim: A Go rewrite might cut 400 ms to 100 ms (about 4x less CPU per render than Node)
claims.about: Go vs Node.js (Express) for CPU-bound request work
claims.measured: CPU fib(20): go-gin 18,218 req/s and go-nethttp 15,093 req/s vs node-express 7,213 req/s (fastify 8,308), so Go is about 2.1–2.5x faster
claims.why: The claimed 4x speedup is higher than the measured 2.1–2.5x, but it is within a factor of 2 of it and points the right way.

claims.claim: If rendering is headless Chromium, the language barely matters; the cost is the browser
claims.about: Headless Chromium rendering driven from any language
claims.why: The benchmarks include no browser-based rendering workload, so there is nothing to compare language overhead against the cost of Chromium.
